name: actionboard-v5-agentformation
description: Turn one objective into a reviewed plan, then execute it with five parallel agents that never touch the same file. Nothing runs until you approve. Actions are risk-classified and gated on scored run history, so nothing executes autonomously until it has proven it can. Briefs, plans, and reports export as Markdown plus schema.org JSON-LD, so a directory of missions becomes a queryable history.
